jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Experienced
jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Medi-Cal Quality Improvement team is responsible for improving preventive care outcomes and increasing member access to quality healthcare services throughout Los Angeles County. The Program Coordinator, Experienced Quality Improvement (HEDIS) will report to the Senior Manager, Medi-Cal Quality Improvement and play a key role in supporting the planning, coordination, and execution of mobile Well Child and Mammogram Clinics at Community Resource Centers (CRCs), provider sites, and community-based locations.

In this role, you will coordinate day-to-day operations related to clinic implementation, scheduling logistics, and performance tracking to help improve preventive care measures, including Well Child Visits, and Breast Cancer Screening.

**This role requires this person to live within 50 miles of the Long Beach office.**

**This is a hybrid field worker role, where this person will be visiting clinics about 75% of the time.**

  

**Your Work**

In this role, you will:

* Coordinate the execution of mobile Well Child and Mammogram Clinics across Community Resource Centers and partner locations throughout Los Angeles County.
* Collaborate with Mobile Clinic Program Manager to ensure clinic readiness and successful event execution.
* Monitor clinic performance metrics, attendance reports, screening completion rates, and HEDIS-related outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain project trackers, clinic dashboards, and databases to support operational and quality improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate meeting logistics, calendars, agendas, and communications for clinic planning and quality improvement activities.
* Assist Quality Improvement Program Managers with implementing strategies designed to improve access to preventive services and achieve departmental and organizational goals.
* Identify and resolve operational barriers related to site location, equipment needs, staffing coordination, and member engagement.
* Collaborate in cross-functional planning efforts with Clinic Program Manager to align mobile clinic operations with Medi-Cal Quality Improvement objectives and community health priorities.
* Manage multiple clinic initiatives simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and customer service.
* Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders and synthesize information from multiple sources to support informed decision-making and successful program implementation.
* Manage support tasks such as monitoring the provider services email box, provider fax blasts, member incentive reconciliation, care gap report quality assurance review, etc.

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* Requires 3 years of prior relevant experience
* This person is required to live within 50 miles of the Long Beach office
* Basic understanding of HEDIS Quality measures preferred
* Member and/or community facing experience preferred
* Bilingual (Spanish) preferred
* Requires a solid understanding of project and resource management, strong business acumen, and team focus.
* Intermediate skill in MS Office products (including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Word)
* Beginner level proficiency in the management of small to medium internal databases, including demonstrated ability to create and manipulate spreadsheets and databases, as well as using graphic software to display results

**Hybrid – Field Worker**

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

We are requiring this person to live within 50 miles of the Long Beach office.

As of January 2025, Blue Shield of California became a subsidiary of Ascendiun. Ascendiun is a nonprofit corporate entity that is the parent to a family of organizations including Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan; Altais, a clinical services company; and Stellarus, a company designed to scale healthcare solutions. Together, these organizations are referred to as the Ascendiun Family of Companies.

At Blue Shield of California, our mission is to create a healthcare system worthy of our family and friends and sustainably affordable. We are transforming health care in a way that genuinely serves our nonprofit mission by lowering costs, improving quality, and enhancing the member and physician experience.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

Here at Blue Shield, we strive to make a positive change across our industry and communities – join us!

jobs.title: Program Specialist - Fellowship Programs
jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20181981 **Category** Administration

  

The University of Southern California (USC), founded in 1880, is located in the heart of downtown L.A. and is the largest private employer in the City of Los Angeles. As an employee of USC, you will be a part of a world-class research university and a member of the "Trojan Family," which is comprised of faculty, students and staff that make the university what it is.

The USC Alfred E. Mann School of Pharmacy, Fellowship Programs, seeks a ***Program Specialist***. The Mission of the USC Mann School of Pharmacy Fellowship Program is to create Post-Doctoral Fellowship training programs that develop professionals to meet future needs. We achieve this by providing innovative, cross-functional, and collaborative training centered on projects while embedded with industry partners. The USC Mann Industry Fellowships are an interdisciplinary partnership providing multi-year fellowships, joint academic and industry research projects, and a culture of belonging and cross-pollination with USC Mann.

  
  

The ***Program Specialist*** is responsible for operational delivery, execution, and coordination of multiple aspects of the Fellowship programs at the USC Mann School of Pharmacy, including but not limited to Fellowship Recruitment, Meeting Logistics, Fellowship Administration, and Finances and Budgets.

  
  

The ***Program Specialist*** responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

* **Operational Delivery and Execution** – Drives completion of assigned tasks in support of priority Fellowship deliverables, utilizing clear and effective communication, collaborative teamwork with internal and external stakeholders, and proactive follow-up and resolution. Utilizes project management and risk management tools including dashboards, project plans, Gantt charts, and trackers to monitor progress and flag risks to delivery, demonstrating good judgement and proposing solutions for overcoming obstacles.
* **Coordination and Organizing** – Utilizes well-developed organizational skills to coordinate both internal and external meetings, according to defined scope, timelines and budgets. Able to develop agendas with stakeholder input and guidance, manage meeting time for impact, efficiency, and effectiveness, organize logistics and tactical details, communicate and liaise with external vendors and speakers, facilitate, oversee, and troubleshoot meeting delivery, and develop, implement, and summarize feedback surveys with spirit of continuous improvement.
* **Fellowship Administration and Recruitment** – Supports Fellowship and individual Fellows in achievement of Program Goals and Professional Objectives throughout life-cycle of program as follows: Recruitment, Interviews/Offers, Program and Industry Partner On-boarding/Orientation, Personal Development Planning, Goal Setting, Quarterly Reports (with Industry Partners), Coursework Registration, Job Search, Program Off-boarding, and Fellowship Graduation. Responsible for accurate, timely, and detail-oriented updates and maintenance of key Fellowship documents including Brochures, Website, Marketing materials, Fellowship information, Application Portal and Interviews, and Offers, and Fellowship Alumni Tracking, Engagement, and Outcomes/Program Assessment.
* **Finances and Budgets** – Monitors and reconciles budget activity, processes financial transactions such as PO, invoices, and expense reimbursement. Directly support the Fellowship Program Directors and other Fellowship Staff with administrative functions as needed.
  

  

The ideal candidate for this role will consistently exhibit and role-model essential leadership and team working behaviors to succeed in this role including: **Communication, Teamwork and Collaboration, Solution-Orientation, Proactivity, and Customer/Client-Focused.** The **Program Specialist reports to the Senior Director, Fellowship Programs** and will work closely with the Program Administrator and other internal and external stakeholders. They will need to be comfortable working with ambiguity, exhibit good judgement, and be able to work with limited supervision.

  
  

**Required & Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience)
* Experience in program coordination, higher education, or related field
* Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* MS Word, PPT, Excel
* Sharepoint

**Preferred:**

* Experience supporting fellowship, residency, or academic programs
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical/biotech industry or clinical research environments
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Trello, Asana, Excel dashboards, Gantt charts)
* Budget tracking or financial operations experience (i.e. concur, workday)
* Survey Monkey, Qualtrics, Google Forms, Web-based surveys
  

  

The hourly rate range for this position is $32.00 - $35.50. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  
  

**This is a 6 month-fixed -term position.**

  
  
Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree, Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education Minimum Experience: 2 years Minimum Field of Expertise: Directly related professional experience in program specialization, e.g., counseling or teaching.

**Job ID** REQ20181981 **Posted Date** 10/14/2026

jobs.title: Southern California Program Specialist
jobs.description:
**Who We Are + What We Do:**

Booster is a mission-driven school fundraising company focused on cultivating virtuous leaders who want to change the world. Booster partners with over 6,000 schools each year and impacts over 3 million students across all 50 states. At the heart of our culture, our six virtues guide everything we do: Gratitude, Wisdom, Care, Courage, Grit, and Celebration. We deliver engaging, innovative, and active fundraising experiences for elementary and middle schools nationwide. From high-energy fun runs to all-in-one fundraising platforms and custom gear, we’ve helped schools raise over $1 billion for education. Booster is a fun, fast-paced, and purpose-filled place to work, where every day offers the opportunity to make a real impact in the lives of students and school communities.

**Are you Booster’s Next Program Specialist?**

As a Program Specialist, you’ll be the face of the Boosterthon program on elementary school campuses. You’ll work alongside a supportive team to help schools reach their fundraising goals, deliver engaging student experiences, and create a positive impact for students and communities. This role is available in both **full-time and part-time** capacities and is ideal for someone early in their career who wants meaningful, hands-on experience.

### **How You’ll Impact Booster’s Mission:**

* Teach and present a character-based curriculum to students
* Set up and host the Boosterthon Fun Run fundraiser
* Motivate students to participate and raise funds for their school
* Engage with teachers, parents, and school administrators
* Model Fitness, Leadership, and Character as part of a team

**What You’ll Bring to The Table:**

Here are some signs that you’d be a great fit for this role:

  

* Excellent Communication - You can connect professionally and enthusiastically with students, faculty, and staff through written and verbal communication.
* Positive Attitude - You display optimism, enthusiasm, and intentionality when interacting with clients and the team.
* Growth Mindset - You demonstrate a continual desire to learn and grow both personally and professionally.
* Good Judgment - You have a strong sense of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.
* Outcome-oriented - You are a hard worker who gets things done in a timely and efficient manner.
* Enthusiastic - You connect enthusiastically with students, faculty, and staff.

**Additional Requirements:**

* You're a licensed driver with reliable transportation
* You can pass Booster's Background and Motor Vehicle check
* You're able to lift up to 45 lbs and remain active throughout the day
* Full-day availability (7:00 am–4:00 pm) on scheduled workdays

**Our Work Environment Includes:**

* Exciting and Engaging Culture: Team events, award ceremonies, epic celebration trips, free lunches, dinners, and more.
* Career Development and Advancement Opportunities
* Recruiting Bonus Opportunities
* Opportunities for National Travel

**Compensation:** $20-$21 per hour, non-exempt

***Are you ready to change the world with us? Follow us on Instagram at @boostercareers for a behind-the-scenes look at life at Booster.***

jobs.description:

We believe people are our most valuable asset, and we proudly foster growth and development empowering you to achieve your professional goals. We have thrived for 60 years and persevered through many economic cycles due to our team members’ drive and optimism. Together we can make a difference in the financial future of our communities.

Apply today!

What our team members are saying:

**General Summary**

  

Under general supervision and following established policies and department procedures, the Social Media Specialist will provide marketing-related support in the areas listed below.

  

**Direct Reports**

  

None

**Essential Functions**

  

* Plan, create, schedule, and publish content across multiple platforms including, Bank’s Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and WeChat accounts.
* Execute social media strategy through competitive research, appropriate brand messaging, and audience identification in English and Chinese.
* Monitor social media channels for trends, conversations, and engagement opportunities.
* Build meaningful internal relationships and encourage team members to support online presence through Cathay Bank content sharing.
* Refresh company pages as needed to improve visibility of the company’s social content.
* Monitor all user-generated content (comments, discussions, posts, and reviews) in line with the Bank’s policies for all platforms.
* Create and maintain editorial calendars and distribution schedules in a timely and organized manner.
* Analyze appropriate social media campaign data/metrics to provide insights, optimization recommendations, industry best practices, and business
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to manage reputation, identify key items, and help create/coordinate future content.
* Support photo/video capture of corporate events, graphic design, and digital marketing campaigns as needed.
* Develop more efficient operational workflows that enhance content creation, publishing, and performance analysis across all platforms.
* Communicate with and manage external vendors and agencies to ensure project deliverables are completed on time.
* Assist in the production of film projects to ensure they align with the company brand’s style.
* Assist with Chinese translation and copywriting.

  

**Qualifications**

  

* **Education:** A. or B.S. in Communications, Marketing, Business, New Media, or Public Relations preferred.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 2-3 years of proven working experience in social media marketing (including general market and Chinese social media platforms) or as a digital media specialist in a related industry. Banking experience a plus.

  + Excellent verbal and written communication, as well as presentation
  + Fluency in reading and writing in English and Chinese (simplified and traditional).
  + High proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  + Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud and Canva.

Willingness to work overtime occasionally to accomplish and meet deadlines.

jobs.title: Development and Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
Header  
**Job Overview**  
The Development and Communications Coordinator leads Beacon Housing's fundraising, grant development, and donor engagement, including the communications that keep donors and funders connected to the work. That support keeps individuals and families vulnerable to homelessness in safe, stable, affordable homes. Reporting to the Executive Director and working closely with staff and the Operating Committee, the Coordinator moves development initiatives from planning through completion: managing timelines, coordinating input from staff and external partners, and producing polished, accurate proposals, reports, and donor materials. This position requires in-person collaboration with staff, donors, funders, Board members, and community partners, along with local travel to Beacon properties and events.

Header  
**Duties**

* Research foundation, corporate, government, and other funding opportunities aligned with Beacon Housing's priorities.
* Maintain the grants and fundraising calendar, coordinate staff contributions, and follow up so that application, reporting, donor engagement, and event deadlines are met.
* Lead grant applications from start to submission: draft proposals, coordinate staff input, gather supporting materials, and manage deadlines.
* Manage grant reporting: track requirements, gather program and financial data, draft reports, and coordinate timely submission.
* Maintain organized records of grants, funders, donors, reporting requirements, and development activities.
* Support donor cultivation and stewardship through communications, updates, acknowledgments, site visits, and other engagement.
* Oversee donor communications, including program updates and all fundraising-related campaigns and activities.
* Work closely with staff to support and coordinate production and promotion of Beacon Housing's Annual Report, with a focus on its donor and funder-facing content.
* Plan and lead fundraising events and campaigns, including the annual pickleball tournament, donor events, and crowdfunding campaigns. Manage timelines, budgets, sponsorships, vendors, invitations, registration, and follow-up.
* Develop and manage communications plans for fundraising events, campaigns, and donor engagement activities.
* Partner with the Social Media Associate to align fundraising and donor messaging across social media and other channels. The Social Media Associate manages day-to-day social media activity.
* Serve as Beacon Housing's media liaison for fundraising events, campaigns, and donor-facing milestones.
* Coordinate photographers, designers, printers, and other outside vendors for donor and fundraising materials.
* Track fundraising results and identify opportunities to strengthen the donor and funding pipeline.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Uphold Beacon Housing's mission through work performed.

Header  
**Skills and Qualifications**

Required:

* Excellent editing, proofreading, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated initiative, attention to detail, sound judgment, and follow-through.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with staff, donors, funders, Board members, partners, and community members.
* Ability to maintain discretion and confidentiality with sensitive donor, resident, and organizational information.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to learn and use communications, fundraising, project management, and database platforms.
* Availability for occasional evening and weekend events and local travel.

Preferred:

* Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Experience in nonprofit communications, fundraising, development, marketing, public relations, or a related field.
* Experience preparing grant applications or reports and coordinating events or fundraising campaigns.
* Experience with email marketing, social media, website content management, Canva or similar platforms, and donor management or CRM systems. Experience with Little Green Light a plus.
* Interest in affordable housing, homelessness prevention, community development, or related social impact work.

Pay: $25.00 - $28.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90039

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Information**

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world's leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you're ready to help create moments that matter, there's a place for you here. Because it happens here.

**Job Summary**

The Social Media Coordinator supports the planning, creation, scheduling, and publishing of engaging digital content across multiple social media platforms and venue accounts. This role assists with content calendars, copywriting, video editing, media organization, digital advertising assets, and influencer campaign support while maintaining effective communication with project managers and the marketing team. The position helps ensure consistent, timely, and brand-aligned social media and digital marketing efforts across all assigned channels.

**What you will do**

* Oversees and maintains various social media accounts across all platforms – Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest
* Devises a consistent content calendar across multiple venues, which includes filling, scheduling, and publishing assets live
* Edits sizzle reels, Instagram Reels, and TikToks. Create and edit basic motion graphics, animations, and visual effects content using Adobe Premiere Pro and/or Adobe After Effects to support video, marketing, and digital media projects.
* Develops engaging copy for captions, press releases, headlines, and calls-to-action (CTAs)
* Organizes and audits media content across multiple venues
* Assists with Social Media ad building, Digital Media buying, and creating Newsletter/Email Blast assets
* Supports influencer campaign strategy and outreach
* Maintains effective communication between project managers and marketing department for content scheduling

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred) in communications, media, or advertisement
* 2-4 years Experience as a media coordinator or similar field
* Knowledge in developing appropriate media content across various platforms
* Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro and Photoshop; Adobe After Effects proficiency preferred
* Ability to foster long-term relationships with vendors, clients, and various business relationships
* Creative thinker with strong conceptual and research skills
* A natural leader who displays strong decision-making and attention to detail
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and writing skills
* Basic understanding of budgeting and advertisement skills
* Must be able to have basic animation skills in either Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects
* Familiarity with social media platforms

**Payscale: $21.79 - $30.85**

**Bonus:** *This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.*

**Benefits:** ***Full-time:*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.*

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee's job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description.

AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants, and we comply with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws in making hiring and employee decisions. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, marital status, disability, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status recognized by applicable federal, state or local law.

  

Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Med Spa Front Desk & Sales Coordinator — Santa Monica ($20–$25/hr + Commission)
jobs.description:
Med Spa Front Desk & Sales Coordinator  
Santa Monica, CA · 4 Days/Week (Saturday Required) · $20–$25/hr + 5% Commission

About Dripology  
Dripology is a luxury med spa and IV therapy brand with locations in Santa Monica and New York City. All treatments are RN-led and physician-supervised. We serve everyone from everyday wellness clients to celebrities, and we've been featured in The Hollywood Reporter, InStyle, The Cut and Us Weekly. We're growing quickly, with new locations and franchising underway, and we're looking for an experienced front desk and sales professional to grow with us.

Please Read Before Applying  
This is not an entry-level position, and we do not provide basic training. You need to have worked at the front desk or in consultative sales at another med spa. You should already know the treatments, the client questions and the sales process. If you don't have prior med spa experience, this role isn't the right fit.

The Role  
You are both the face of the clinic and the person who books the business. You'll create a five-star experience for every client who walks in or calls. You'll also lead consultations that turn inquiries into booked treatments, packages and memberships. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, spots opportunities and adds value from their first week.

Responsibilities

*Front Desk & Client Experience*

* Greet and check in clients with a warm, polished, luxury level of hospitality
* Answer phones, texts, DMs and web inquiries quickly and professionally

jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** M-F 9:30AM-6PM (can be flexible anytime 8AM-7PM)
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
Building on this mission, the Prototypes Housing, a program of HealthRIGHT 360, provides housing and case management services for women and women with children across Los Angeles County through three core programs that support clients along the housing continuum. Recovery Bridge Housing (RBH) offers short-term, recovery-focused interim housing for unhoused adults and perinatal women engaged in outpatient substance use treatment, emphasizing life skills development within a 90-day period to promote long-term stability. The Bridge Housing program serves individuals with behavioral health needs who are experiencing homelessness by providing interim housing and supportive services until they secure permanent placement. The Continuum of Care (COC), funded through LAHSA, delivers permanent housing solutions focused on sustained stability for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. Across all programs, Prototypes provides comprehensive case management, including assessments, individualized service planning, resource linkage, and ongoing support to help clients achieve lasting recovery and housing stability.
  
  
Aligned with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission to advance health equity and the Prototypes Housing continuum serving women and families across Los Angeles County, the Administrative Coordinator supports daily operations that ensure safe, stable housing by maintaining housing readiness, tracking client census and bed availability, coordinating unit turnover, and managing maintenance requests. This role also supports administrative functions by maintaining documentation systems, managing workflows and supply levels, and coordinating communication across multidisciplinary teams to support efficient service delivery and positive client housing outcomes in alignment with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission and values.

Housing Operations Support
  

* Maintain daily client census and track bed availability to support admissions and program flow.
* Ensure unit readiness by coordinating room turnover, cleanliness, and appropriate housing conditions.
* Submit and track maintenance requests; follow up to ensure timely completion of repairs. This may include traveling to off-site RBH locations in Pomona.
* Collaborate with supervisors and managers to optimize housing utilization and client placement.
* Maintain inventory of housing supplies including toiletries, linens, and bedding.
* Monitor supply levels and coordinate replenishment to ensure consistent availability for clients.
* Organize and manage storage areas to ensure accessibility and efficiency.
* Transport clients if necessary.

Office Support
  

* Maintain office organization, including filing systems and administrative processes.
* Support overall office efficiency by coordinating tasks and improving workflow systems.
* Assist with documentation and internal administrative tracking as needed.

Collaboration
  

* Serve as a liaison between administrative offices and program departments, including Outpatient and Residential teams.
* Facilitate clear and consistent communication to support daily operations and client care.
* Work closely with supervisors and management to address operational needs and priorities.

Compliance
  

* Maintain and uphold all applicable HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 regulations.
* Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of client and organizational information.
* Follow all organizational policies and procedures related to documentation and privacy.
* Attend and complete assigned trainings.
* Attend and participate in meetings and events.
* Read and respond to emails in a timely manner.

And perform other duties as assigned.

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Higher education preferred.
* Valid First Aid and CPR certification or ability to obtain within the required timeline.

Million Dollar Baby Co. started in 1990 and is proudly family-owned and operated in Los Angeles. Since then, MDB has grown to 7 distinct brands of children's furnishings ranging in style, aesthetic, and price, while carrying some of the industry's most eco-conscious and award-winning designs. We can be found in retailers like Target and Amazon, and specialty retailers like Pottery Barn Kids and Crate & Barrel.
  
  
Under the Million Dollar Baby Co. parent company are our family of brands: **Babyletto, daVinci, Nursery Works, and Namesake.** We're proud to offer the most **Greenguard Gold–certified** cribs on the market and to use **FSC-certified** sustainable wood across our brands whenever possible. We've also pioneered Styrofoam-free packaging for several of our best-selling collections — an innovation that reduces waste while protecting our products during shipment.  
  
At Million Dollar Baby Co., our team members are our #1 priority, and we partner with exceptional partners and retailers around the world who share our core values:  
  

* **Treat Your Team Like Family** — lead with respect, gratitude, empathy, and kindness.
* **Make an Impact, Drive Results** — focus on meaningful work that moves families forward.
* **Deliver a "Wow" Customer Experience Every Time** — every detail matters.
* **Strive for Continuous Improvement & Learning** — keep growing, keep getting better.
* **Cultivate Quality Conversations** — communicate honestly and thoughtfully to build trust.

  
Over the years, our commitment to people, innovation, and a positive workplace culture has earned us five consecutive **"Best Place to Work"** awards, one of the best workplaces by **"Built in LA"**, a 4.6 rating on **Glassdoor**, and 13 years on the **Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Companies** list — recognitions that reflect the heart of who we are and the community we're proud to build. * Review all submitted content against brief and brand standards before it goes live

* Own and organize the UGC asset library — archiving, tagging, and surfacing evergreen content for repurposing

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Proactively surface seasonal best-seller opportunities to the broader marketing team

* Serve as the point of contact between the marketing team and PR agency — providing product information, brand context, and timely support

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

jobs.description:
Description:

**About GoodSuite**

GoodSuite is a boutique technology services company with 28 years of operating history, headquartered in Woodland Hills, CA. We serve businesses across Southern California with managed IT services, imaging solutions, AV, and emerging technology offerings. With a 95%+ client retention rate and a culture built on ownership, speed, and continuous development, we are on an aggressive growth path toward $25M in revenue by 2027.

*We operate with a Mamba Mentality — we outwork, out-think, and out-serve. We are not looking for someone to maintain the status quo. We are looking for someone to help us redefine what’s possible.*

**Position Summary**

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as the strategic owner of assigned IT client accounts, acting as GoodSuite's primary advisor and long-term technology partner. As a trusted technology advisor, the TAM is responsible for building strong executive relationships, maintaining an active technology roadmap, aligning client environments to GoodSuite standards, and driving long-term client success.

This is a growth role. The TAM is accountable for retention, client satisfaction, and new revenue, achieved through project delivery, roadmap execution, security improvements, and recurring service expansion. In addition to managing a portfolio of 30 to 35 IT clients, the TAM is expected to actively pursue new IT business within GoodSuite's large base of imaging and print clients who do not yet use our IT services.

The TAM serves as the client advocate and escalation point inside GoodSuite, ensuring service delivery teams have the context and prioritization needed to support the client effectively. While the TAM maintains strategic oversight of service quality, the role does not manage day-to-day ticket dispatch or service coordination, allowing the TAM to remain focused on account development and growth.

**Account Growth & Revenue Responsibility**

The TAM is responsible for driving revenue growth against a monthly new revenue target. All new revenue counts toward this target, whether it comes from the assigned IT portfolio or from imaging clients converted to IT services.

Projects are a primary growth driver for this role. The TAM is expected to consistently identify, scope, propose, and close project work, including:

* Technology lifecycle refresh initiatives
* Infrastructure modernization and cloud migration projects
* Cybersecurity posture improvements and compliance initiatives
* Professional services and project delivery
* Expansion of managed services and recurring service agreements
* Hardware, licensing, and platform optimization aligned to GoodSuite standards

The TAM follows a consistent account development model across every client, using roadmap planning, quarterly business reviews, and lifecycle management to identify and advance opportunities.

Each TAM is expected to maintain a forward-looking project pipeline at all times, with multiple project opportunities actively in progress, ensuring ongoing modernization, security maturity improvements, and infrastructure alignment with GoodSuite best practices.

**Client Base Expansion (New IT Growth)**

GoodSuite serves a large base of imaging and print clients who already trust us but do not yet use our IT services. The TAM is expected to hunt within this base, opening new IT relationships and converting them into managed services and project clients.

* Work a defined target list of imaging clients each quarter, prioritized by IT fit and opportunity size
* Partner with imaging account representatives on warm introductions, joint visits, and account planning
* Lead discovery conversations, IT assessments, and security reviews to uncover needs and create opportunities
* Use projects and assessments as entry points to establish new IT relationships
* Build proposals and convert opportunities into managed services agreements and project work
* Maintain an accurate, current opportunity pipeline in Salesforce with clear stages and next steps

Expected time allocation: approximately 70% portfolio management and growth, 30% client base expansion.

**Strategic Advisory**

* Serve as a trusted technology advisor to client leadership, developing a deep understanding of their business operations, goals, and IT environment
* Translate technology requirements into clear, actionable business solutions that deliver measurable value
* Advise clients on IT architecture, cybersecurity strategy, lifecycle planning, and technology investments aligned with their business objectives
* Develop and maintain a documented technology roadmap and budget forecast for each assigned client
* Educate client leadership on emerging technology trends, cybersecurity risks, and operational best practices
* Bring in GoodSuite engineering and leadership resources for complex architecture and strategy decisions

**Standards, Security, and Lifecycle Governance**

* Maintain a current 'baseball card' technical profile for each client environment documenting infrastructure standards and security posture
* Evaluate client environments against GoodSuite standards and identify improvement opportunities
* Drive remediation of security, infrastructure, and lifecycle risks through structured improvement plans
* Partner with service leadership and engineering teams to implement security improvements and best-practice configurations
* Ensure lifecycle planning for critical infrastructure including servers, networking, security platforms, and endpoint environments
* Maintain an active multi-year technology roadmap for each client

**Strategic Account Management**

* Own the long-term strategic relationship with assigned clients including executive and operational stakeholders
* Maintain a living technology roadmap and improvement plan for each account
* Conduct structured Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) reviewing roadmap progress, service trends, and upcoming initiatives
* Identify and advance technology

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 15 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role.

Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Hardware Partnerships
jobs.description:
**About us**

Gimlet is building the first multi-silicon neocloud designed for fast, efficient AI inference.

We combine large-scale compute infrastructure with an execution platform that partitions AI workloads and maps each stage to the hardware best suited to run it.

We work with foundation labs, hyperscalers, and AI-native companies, giving our team access to technical problems spanning frontier models, production infrastructure, and emerging hardware.

**About the role**

As Project Coordinator, Hardware Partnerships, you will be a force multiplier for Gimlet Labs’ Hardware Partnerships team. Gimlet is building a heterogeneous AI cloud, and its hardware relationships span technical evaluations, POCs, commercial negotiations, financing, supply and deployment. You will help the team keep those parallel threads organized and moving.

You will work closely with the Hardware Partnerships lead and partnership owners to prepare partner meetings, maintain Notion pages and trackers, capture actions and commitments, and follow through across Engineering, GTM, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Infrastructure and PMO. Partnership owners lead strategy and own the overall partner outcome; you make them more effective by keeping information, milestones and dependencies clear. As you build context and judgment, you may take ownership of smaller workstreams directly.

Exceptional organization, follow-through, judgment and learning agility matter more than a specific title or years of project-management experience.

**What success looks like**

In the first 12-18 months, you will:

* Prepare partner meetings with current context, open items, decisions needed and required inputs so the team can use meeting time effectively
* Capture actions, decisions and commitments with clear owners and deadlines, and follow through until they are resolved
* Keep Notion partnership pages, trackers and project information accurate, current and easy to use across the portfolio
* Track technical evaluations, POCs, commercial workstreams and deployment milestones, keeping progress and upcoming commitments visible
* Coordinate dependencies and deliverables across Engineering, GTM, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Infrastructure, PMO and partner teams
* Surface risks, blockers, overdue actions and decisions early, using judgment about what to resolve directly and what to escalate
* Build lightweight status updates and repeatable operating rhythms that reduce the time partnership owners spend reconstructing context and chasing follow-ups
* Take ownership of smaller projects or work streams as your context and capability grow, with clear scope and accountability

**You may be a good fit if you have**

* Exceptional organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple parallel threads
* High attention to detail while keeping the most important priorities in view
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn messy discussions into clear actions and concise updates
* Sound judgment and discretion, including knowing when to act independently and when to escalate
* The ability to adjust quickly as priorities, information and deadlines change
* High agency and a proactive approach to noticing gaps, solving problems and closing the loop
* Learning agility and curiosity, with the ability to build context across technical, commercial and operational topics
* Comfort working across functions and following up persistently and professionally with busy internal and external stakeholders

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience in project or program coordination, team operations or executive support
* Experience maintaining Notion or similar collaboration and project-tracking tools
* Experience in hardware, AI infrastructure, cloud or another technology company
* Experience supporting technical teams or coordinating complex cross-functional projects
* Experience in partner- or customer-facing work, including meeting preparation and tracking external commitments

**Why join now?**

Gimlet is expanding from its core technology into a production neocloud spanning new hardware, customers, and data centers.

* Solve hard problems.
* Own meaningful work.
* Build for production.
* Help define what’s next.

*Agency Policy:* *Gimlet Labs does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without a signed agreement will be considered the property of Gimlet Labs, and no fees will be paid.*

Compensation Range: $150K - $195K

jobs.title: Credentialing and Licensing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview:

Marin Community Clinics, founded in 1972, is today, a multi-clinic network with a wide array of integrated primary care, dental, behavioral, specialty and referral services. As a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), we provide vital health services to almost 40,000 individuals annually in Marin County. The Clinics regularly receive national awards from the Health Resources and Services Administrations (HRSA). Our Mission is to promote health and wellness through excellent, compassionate care for all.

The Credentialing and Licensing Coordinator maintains MCC's organizational licenses, permits, registrations, and regulatory records and supports initial credentialing and recredentialing for clinical staff. The position coordinates complete, timely files for review and approval, monitors expirations and renewal cycles, and escalates barriers that could affect workforce readiness or clinic operations.

Responsibilities:

**Licensing and Permit Administration**

* Maintain an accurate inventory, renewal calendar, required postings, and audit-ready files for licenses, permits, registrations, certificates, fees, and agency correspondence.
* Coordinate applications, renewals, amendments, relocations, service changes, closures, and terminations within required timeframes.
* Support applicable California Department of Public Health (CDPH), California State Board of Pharmacy, laboratory, radiologic, dental, medical-waste, hazardous-material, fire, occupancy, and local business requirements.
* Monitor agency communications and promptly escalate questions, deficiencies, or time-sensitive issues to accountable leaders and Compliance, as appropriate.
* Coordinate with HRSA scope, payer enrollment, NPI, Facilities, Finance, Pharmacy, and other owners to keep site and service information align.

**I****nitial Credentialing and Recredentialing**

* Coordinate initial credentialing and recredentialing for licensed independent practitioners and other assigned clinical workforce members in accordance with MCC policy and applicable accreditation, HRSA, and payer requirements.
* Collect and review applications, attestations, disclosures, supporting documents, and requested updates; identify omissions, inconsistencies, and items requiring follow-up.
* Complete and document required primary-source verifications, including licensure, education, training, board status, work history, references, sanctions, exclusions, malpractice history, NPDB, and DEA or CURES information when applicable.
* Monitor expiring credentials and recredentialing cycles; conduct timely outreach and escalate incomplete or overdue requirements before they affect eligibility to practice.
* Maintain accurate provider demographics, credentialing data, verification dates, documents, status, and workflow activity in the approved credentialing system.
* Protect confidential credentialing, peer-review, workforce, and provider information in accordance with MCC requirements.

**Privileging and Approval Support**

* Prepare complete credentialing and privileging files, summaries, reports, and agenda materials for Credentialing and Privileging Committee and other required approval bodies.
* Coordinate initial, renewed, or revised privileges so requested services, sites, competencies, and supporting documentation are clearly presented for review.
* Obtain required competency, peer-review, OPPE, FPPE, or other reappointment information from responsible clinical leaders when applicable.
* Document approvals, conditions, effective dates, expiration dates, and follow-up actions; credentialing and privileging decisions remain with authorized committees and leaders.

**Records, Readiness, and Collaboration**

* Maintain organized, audit-ready credentialing and licensing records and produce reports for leadership, committee, survey, audit, and operational needs.
* Coordinate with clinical leadership, Human Resources, Payer Enrollment, Compliance, Operations, Quality, and others to resolve dependencies and maintain aligned records.
* Communicate requirements and deadlines clearly, track assigned actions, and escalate unresolved risks or delays through the defined management pathway.
* Perform other related duties and projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, public administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered.
* Three years of healthcare credentialing, licensing, medical staff services, accreditation, regulatory operations, or related experience desired.
* Experience with primary-source verification, credentialing databases, expiration tracking, committee preparation, and confidential records.
* FQHC or multi-site ambulatory healthcare experience and familiarity with California licensing, HRSA, payer, and Joint Commission requirements preferred.
* National Association Medical Staff Services (NAMSS) credentialing education or certification.
* Bilingual English/Spanish skills preferred.

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Strong organization, accuracy, attention to detail, follow-through, and deadline management.
* Ability to interpret requirements, identify missing or inconsistent information, and maintain defensible documentation.
* Sound judgment regarding when to proceed, verify, pause, or escalate.
* Clear written and verbal communication and ability to coordinate work across clinical and administrative teams.
* Proficiency with credentialing systems, Microsoft 365, shared repositories, spreadsheets, and reporting tools.
* Professional discretion, adaptability, and commitment to patient-centered service, integrity, and continuous improvement.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions**

* Fulfill immunization and fit for duty regulatory requirements.
* Office and clinic-based work with regular travel between MCC sites and occasional early-morning or evening meetings.

For nearly five decades, we have met people where they are—providing safety, resources, and support they need to move toward stability and home.

Position Summary: As part of the Development team, the Development Coordinator supports Community Forward SF’s fundraising efforts by processing donations; maintaining donor records, preparing reports, coordinating communications and events logistics; and supporting donor stewardship and engagement. Under the direction of the Director of Development, the Coordinator supports daily operations and executes fundraising and engagement activities.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

**Development Operations, CRM, & Gift Processing**

  

* Process, record, and acknowledge all gifts, pledges, pledge payments, and in-kind donations accurately and promptly.
* Create and maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date donor and constituent records in Salesforce, including entering new contacts and updating existing information.
* Collaborate with the Director of Development and the Finance department on monthly reconciliation.
* Manage Salesforce data imports, exports, queries, list segmentation, dashboards, and reports to support fundraising, donor engagement, volunteer metrics, and departmental decision-making.
* Conduct regular data audits, maintain CRM documentation and procedures, and identify opportunities to improve data quality, systems, and workflows.

**Development Communications**

  

* Support the execution of our communications plan in coordination with the Director of Development and Vice President of Philanthropy, including drafting and editing fundraising appeals, donor communications, event promotions, impact stories, social media content, and other digital and print materials.
* Coordinate with designers and other vendors on direct mail campaigns, annual reports, event materials, and other collateral.
* Maintain website content and develop, schedule, and publish social media posts across relevant platforms.
* Monitor and report on digital performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement.

**Event Planning & Logistics**

  

* Under the direction of the Director of Development, coordinate and execute logistics for fundraising, donor cultivation, stewardship, and community events, including the annual Community Forward Ball.
* Maintain event databases, guest lists, and communications through Greater Giving, ensuring accurate integration with Salesforce.
* Coordinate assigned day-of event logistics, including setup, guest registration, vendor communications, and Fund-a-Need support.
* Coordinate post-event reconciliation, gift entry, acknowledgments, data cleanup, and reporting in partnership with the Director of Development and Finance.

**Development Coordination & Support**

  

* Coordinate volunteer activities, including recruitment support, logistics, scheduling, and volunteer recognition in collaboration with the Development team.
* Coordinate in-kind donations including maintaining organizational wishlists and managing distribution in collaboration with Programs.
* Conduct prospect and donor research and prepare briefing materials.
* Coordinate scheduling, meeting preparation, and other administrative needs for the Development team and organizational leadership.
* Represent Community Forward SF professionally when interacting with donors, partners, vendors, and other external stakeholders.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE:**

  

* 2-3 years of relevant professional experience in nonprofit development, fundraising operations, database management, communications, events, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
* Commitment to Community Forward’s mission, values, and the communities we serve.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines, and independently manage assigned responsibilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and commitment to maintaining high-quality data and administrative processes.
* Experience with CRM or database systems (Salesforce preferred) and proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for data management and reporting.
* Strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop content for different audiences and build positive working relationships.
* Maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion with sensitive donor and organizational information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience coordinating nonprofit fundraising events, including vendor logistics, guest registration, and event-related data management.
* Experience with email marketing platforms, website content management systems, and social media management tools.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.

**Job Overview**

Our company is an international event execution firm headquartered in China, with an established branch in Thailand, and we are currently building and expanding our new U.S. branch. With over 26 years of experience in AV, lighting, and live event production, we deliver professional and creative solutions for clients across industries, including automotive events, exhibitions/trade shows, and product launches. As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

You will own your territory as a business, driving growth through a combination of new business development, market insight, and trusted relationships.

  
  

This role requires more than execution. It demands the ability to understand complex customer environments, navigate networks, position differentiated solutions, and convert opportunity into sustained growth.

  
  

You will be expected to win—consistently and competitively—while building credibility as a partner to scientific and business stakeholders. This is a high-performance, high-accountability environment where results matter, and how you win matters just as much.

  
  

**Role Purpose**

Act as the strategic owner of the territory, aligning customer needs, market dynamics, and internal expertise to achieve commercial success.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

*Territory & Business Leadership*

* Develop and execute a comprehensive, data-driven territory strategy
* Identify market opportunities, whitespace, and growth vectors
* Own territory performance, including revenue, pipeline, and forecast accuracy
  

  

*Business Development & Pipeline Generation*

* Proactively create, qualify, and advance new opportunities
* Build and maintain a robust, balanced pipeline
* Compete effectively to win new business and displace incumbents
  

  

*Account Management & Relationship Expansion*

* Build and expand multi-level relationships across customer organizations
* Map stakeholder networks and navigate complex decision-making environments
* Leverage relationships to drive long-term account growth and retention
  

  

*Solution Selling & Value Creation*

* Deliver consultative, insight-led engagement with customers
* Position integrated solutions across instruments, consumables, services, and software
* Translate technical and scientific needs into clear commercial outcomes
  

  

*Opportunity & Deal Execution*

* Lead opportunity strategy from qualification through close
* Manage complex deal cycles with discipline and precision
* Negotiate effectively to achieve strong commercial outcomes
  

  

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Partner with Technical Sales Specialists, Application Scientists, Service, and Strategic Accounts
* Align internal expertise to deliver coordinated, high-value solutions
* Act as the central point of orchestration for customer engagement
  

  

*Market & Competitive Intelligence*

* Maintain deep understanding of territory dynamics, customer needs, and competitive landscape
* Position Waters solutions effectively to differentiate and win
* Provide insights to inform broader commercial strategy
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistently meets or exceeds territory revenue and growth targets
* Builds and converts a high-quality, scalable pipeline
* Wins competitive opportunities and expands market share
* Develops strong, trusted customer relationships that drive long-term value
* Demonstrates clear market insight and strategic account planning
* Maintains high standards of forecast accuracy and execution discipline
* Recognized as a trusted partner internally and externally
  

  

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Business, or related field
* 3–5+ years of sales or commercial experience
* Experience in life sciences, diagnostics, healthcare, or related industries
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets
* Experience managing customer relationships and driving growth
* Ability to manage multiple complex opportunities simultaneously
* Willingness to travel within assigned territory
  

  

**Preferred**

* Experience with capital equipment and/or solution-based selling
* Familiarity with Flow Cytometry and laboratory environments preferred.
* Experience engaging technical and executive stakeholders
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and analytics tools
  

  

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic Territory Management

jobs.description:
This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus.

Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Irvine, CA, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 15 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role.
* Experience with core cloud computing concepts and enterprise architecture principles, including networking (VPC, peering), compute, storage, IT security (IAM, segmentation, encryption), database systems, cloud-native application development, and operational frameworks.
* Experience presenting to technical and executive stakeholders, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting customers in critical cloud operations domains, including launch/capacity planning, product release management, technical support, or formalized escalation management procedures.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master's degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Relevant technical professional certifications.
* Experience leading technical governance activities, such as establishing or actively participating in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), or developing reference architectures and reusable patterns for an enterprise organization.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Technical Success Account Manager (TSAM), you will serve as a strategic technical leader aligned with Google Cloud’s most critical customers. You are responsible for driving sustained platform health, achieving technical excellence, and ensuring stability for key business critical workloads running on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

The TSAM serves as the customer’s trusted technical advisor, translating complex business objectives into rigorous technical governance and modern, resilient cloud architectural strategies. You will advocate for adoption of industry best practices and act as the primary point of accountability for resolving platform challenges and proactive risk mitigation, to the satisfaction of executive stakeholders.

This role requires independently forging strong executive relationships, advocating for the implementation of Google Cloud architecture standards, elevating platform stability, and establishing technical accuracy across the customer’s GCP footprint, through a programmatic approach. Additionally, you will serve as the internal customer advocate, translating their strategic needs into actionable feedback for Google Cloud’s Product and Engineering teams, ensuring continuous service improvement and feature development.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $224000 - $311000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Establish and lead Technical Governance, focusing on platform health metrics and enterprise readiness planning.
* Provide technical guidance and advocate for the adoption of Google Cloud architecture and best practices via deep dives and workshops.
* Drive platform stability and excellence through deep architectural health assessments.
* Serve as the strategic technical advisor to address and resolve critical reliability concerns, advising on and guiding the architecture of highly robust, scalable, and resilient workloads.
* Act as the internal customer advocate, translating technical obstacles to influence GCP product roadmaps. Own workload success, stabilization, and ongoing optimization to ensure sustained business value.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

jobs.description:
**Title:** Inbound Sales Development Representative

**Location:** San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)

**Compensation:** $50,000 - $52,500 base + uncapped commission

**Job Type:** Full-time

**About Us**

Demandforce, founded in 2003 and based in San Francisco, is an award-winning software company helping small businesses grow through smarter communication. Our platform includes marketing automation, appointment reminders, reputation management, and 24/7 online booking.

We’re a fast-paced, collaborative team committed to helping businesses thrive—and we’re growing fast! Our Sales Development Representatives work closely with Account Executives to understand prospective customers’ business needs, identify the right opportunities, and create a strong first experience with Demandforce.

**What’s in it for you:**

* $50,000 - $52,500 base salary + uncapped commission
* Paid training + 2-month commission guarantee
* Career advancement path to Account Executive
* Hands-on experience with sales tools and technology, including Salesforce and ZoomInfo
* Ongoing sales coaching and development
* A collaborative, supportive team environment
* Communication, discovery, and sales skills you can build on throughout your career

**Who You Are:**

* Motivated, competitive, and goal-oriented
* A strong conversationalist who can build rapport quickly
* Naturally curious and comfortable asking questions to understand what a prospect really needs
* Comfortable thinking on your feet and navigating unexpected questions
* Organized and able to manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and lead sources at once
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
* Confident on the phone and comfortable communicating through phone, email, and live chat
* Able to recognize buying signals, uncover a prospect’s needs, and confidently guide the conversation toward a next step
* Coachable, open to feedback, and interested in continuously improving
* Resilient - not every conversation results in a meeting. You know when to push, when to pivot, and how to move on to the next opportunity
* Able to work independently and in a team

**How You’ll Do It:**

This is not a traditional cold-calling-only SDR role. You’ll be one of the first people prospective customers speak with when they contact Demandforce.

Throughout the day, you’ll respond to inbound leads from phone calls, website inquiries, live chat, marketing campaigns, and other channels while also completing outbound follow-up. The role averages approximately 65 inbound and outbound calls per day in addition to email and chat activity.

Some prospects will know exactly what they’re looking for. Others may simply know they have a problem they want to solve. Your job is to quickly understand what’s happening in their business, ask the right questions, communicate how Demandforce may be able to help, and determine whether it makes sense to schedule a deeper conversation with an Account Executive.

You’ll need to balance speed with quality. Responding quickly matters, but so does making each conversation count.

* Respond quickly to new inbound prospects and follow up consistently
* Build rapport and lead productive, consultative conversations
* Ask strong discovery questions to understand the prospect’s business, challenges, and priorities
* Identify qualified opportunities and confidently ask prospects to schedule a meeting
* Handle common questions and objections without getting thrown off
* Maintain organized follow-up across calls, email, chat, and sales tools
* Work closely with Account Executives to create a smooth handoff and give them useful context before each appointment
* Learn Demandforce’s products, customers, competitors, and the industries we serve
* Participate in ongoing coaching and development
* Meet activity, appointment-setting, and performance goals

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off + holidays
* FSA for medical and dependent care
* Life & disability insurance
* Commuter benefits, EAP, and more

At Internet Brands, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the compensation for this role to depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

In addition to our awesome culture, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health and well-being of you and your family. Our benefits include health insurance options such as medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA) for medical and dependent care, short-term and long-term disability insurance, and life and AD&D insurance. We also provide a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, commuter benefits as well as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and well-being coaching services. In addition, employees can take advantage of voluntary benefits such as home, auto and pet insurance, and discounted legal and financial services. For more details, feel free to inquire during the interview process.

Internet Brands®, headquartered in El Segundo, Calif, is a fully integrated online media and software services company focused on four high-value vertical categories: Health, Automotive, Legal, and Home/Travel. The company's properties and platforms include the WebMD, Medscape, and Henry Schein ONE networks, which are the global leaders in their markets; Nolo, Avvo, and Martindale, which form the largest consumer information provider in the legal market; and CarsDirect, Fodor's Travel, and many others which are leaders in their key vertical markets. Vesta Home (dba Showroom Group) is changing the way that homes are marketed-and furniture is sold. We're obsessed with the client experience for our full-service offerings: interior design, luxury staging, elevated furniture rentals and custom furniture production, fueled by our proprietary technology and logistics expertise.

* Accurately track all activity, contacts, and opportunities in Salesforce CRM and related sales tools.
* Maintain clean and organized prospect and pipeline data in accordance with company standards.
* Represent the company professionally in all early-stage outreach and communications.
* Educate prospective clients on the company’s services and value proposition.
* Provide regular updates on activity levels, meetings scheduled, and pipeline contribution to Sales Leadership.
* Support regional initiatives, marketing campaigns, and sales programs as directed by the Senior Regional Sales Director.
* Collaborate closely with the Core Sales team, Channel Sales team, and Sales Leadership to ensure smooth handoff of qualified opportunities.

  
**Requirements**  

* 2+ years of experience in business development, outbound sales, or a related client-facing role.
* Proven success in a hunter-style sales or business development role focused on generating net new opportunities.
* Experience working in a metrics-driven or quota-driven sales environment preferred.
* Experience with outbound prospecting, lead qualification, or meeting setting strongly preferred.
* Experience selling to real estate professionals, developers, or related industries is a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable making outbound calls and conducting high-volume outreach.
* Experience using CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce, Apollo, Instantly, SmartLead, Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, or similar).
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-oriented environment.
* Self-motivated, disciplined, and able to work independently while collaborating with the regional sales team.

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
