jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Performs varied secretarial and administrative duties exercising considerable discretion and independent judgment including or comparable to most of the following:

* Perform secretarial and administrative duties and maintain office in absence of the Divisional Sr. VP. Expedite requests from corporate management directed to the Divisional Sr. VP and perform administrative follow up for the Divisional Sr. VP on pending matters.
* Compose, type, and transcribe routine correspondence, reports, forms, and similar material in final form using a personal computer. Ensure correctly worded documents with a professional appearance at all times.
* Compile special reports and charts, requiring data collection from several sources, based on specific instructions as to the nature and purpose of these charts and reports. Participate in the budgeting process as needed.
* Establish and maintain confidential files, files of corporate records, official documents, and other information for reference purposes. Research files for information upon request. Dispose of records according to established retention procedures.
* Maintain office controls to ensure the timely submission of correspondence and reports. Consolidate reports when appropriate.
* Research and resolve inquiries related to the function of the division.
* Process payment for invoices and maintains departmental billing, budget, and payment data.
* Participate in the budget process as requested, i.e. review budget reports, monitor variances, enter data in budget system, etc.
* Screen telephone calls and visitors; route misdirected calls to other appropriate individuals in the organization. Open, scan, and arrange mail in order of importance. Schedule appointments, maintain master calendar and place outgoing phone calls for the Divisional Sr. VP. Provide, prepare or obtain information from records based on knowledge of the organization.
* Assume responsibility for keeping up to date on organizational changes, and corporate policies and procedures. Safeguard the confidentiality of all information related to executive functions.
* Handle special projects including scheduling and coordinating meetings, making travel arrangements, arranging for luncheons, and sending out invitations. Attend management and other meetings for the Divisional Sr. VP. Prepare summaries of decisions and commitments made at meetings and conferences.
* Perform various miscellaneous functions, i.e., maintain personal files, screen internal/external publications outlining pertinent information. Advise support staff in answering problems involving procedural and workflow.
* Maintain a thorough knowledge of the organizational structure.
* May lead other administrative assistants within the division.
* Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with co-workers, management, customers, etc.
* Comply with HIPAA, Diversity Principles, Corporate Integrity, Compliance Program policies and other applicable corporate and departmental policies.
* Maintain complete confidentiality of company business.
* Maintain communication with management regarding developments within areas of assigned responsibilities and perform special projects as required or requested.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

* High School Diploma or G.E.D.
* 3 years of administrative support experience.
* Knowledge of office procedures and equipment.
* Verbal and written communication skills, including punctuation, composition, sentence structure, etc.
* High degree of confidentiality
* Independent judgment and initiative and act with authority as needed.
* PC proficiency to include Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Lotus Notes
* exercising confidentiality, tact and diplomacy

Pay: $30.00 - $31.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60601

new_jobs.title: Program Specialist - Fellowship Programs
new_jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20181981 **Category** Administration

  

The University of Southern California (USC), founded in 1880, is located in the heart of downtown L.A. and is the largest private employer in the City of Los Angeles. As an employee of USC, you will be a part of a world-class research university and a member of the "Trojan Family," which is comprised of faculty, students and staff that make the university what it is.

The USC Alfred E. Mann School of Pharmacy, Fellowship Programs, seeks a ***Program Specialist***. The Mission of the USC Mann School of Pharmacy Fellowship Program is to create Post-Doctoral Fellowship training programs that develop professionals to meet future needs. We achieve this by providing innovative, cross-functional, and collaborative training centered on projects while embedded with industry partners. The USC Mann Industry Fellowships are an interdisciplinary partnership providing multi-year fellowships, joint academic and industry research projects, and a culture of belonging and cross-pollination with USC Mann.

  
  

The ***Program Specialist*** is responsible for operational delivery, execution, and coordination of multiple aspects of the Fellowship programs at the USC Mann School of Pharmacy, including but not limited to Fellowship Recruitment, Meeting Logistics, Fellowship Administration, and Finances and Budgets.

  
  

The ***Program Specialist*** responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

* **Operational Delivery and Execution** – Drives completion of assigned tasks in support of priority Fellowship deliverables, utilizing clear and effective communication, collaborative teamwork with internal and external stakeholders, and proactive follow-up and resolution. Utilizes project management and risk management tools including dashboards, project plans, Gantt charts, and trackers to monitor progress and flag risks to delivery, demonstrating good judgement and proposing solutions for overcoming obstacles.
* **Coordination and Organizing** – Utilizes well-developed organizational skills to coordinate both internal and external meetings, according to defined scope, timelines and budgets. Able to develop agendas with stakeholder input and guidance, manage meeting time for impact, efficiency, and effectiveness, organize logistics and tactical details, communicate and liaise with external vendors and speakers, facilitate, oversee, and troubleshoot meeting delivery, and develop, implement, and summarize feedback surveys with spirit of continuous improvement.
* **Fellowship Administration and Recruitment** – Supports Fellowship and individual Fellows in achievement of Program Goals and Professional Objectives throughout life-cycle of program as follows: Recruitment, Interviews/Offers, Program and Industry Partner On-boarding/Orientation, Personal Development Planning, Goal Setting, Quarterly Reports (with Industry Partners), Coursework Registration, Job Search, Program Off-boarding, and Fellowship Graduation. Responsible for accurate, timely, and detail-oriented updates and maintenance of key Fellowship documents including Brochures, Website, Marketing materials, Fellowship information, Application Portal and Interviews, and Offers, and Fellowship Alumni Tracking, Engagement, and Outcomes/Program Assessment.
* **Finances and Budgets** – Monitors and reconciles budget activity, processes financial transactions such as PO, invoices, and expense reimbursement. Directly support the Fellowship Program Directors and other Fellowship Staff with administrative functions as needed.
  

  

The ideal candidate for this role will consistently exhibit and role-model essential leadership and team working behaviors to succeed in this role including: **Communication, Teamwork and Collaboration, Solution-Orientation, Proactivity, and Customer/Client-Focused.** The **Program Specialist reports to the Senior Director, Fellowship Programs** and will work closely with the Program Administrator and other internal and external stakeholders. They will need to be comfortable working with ambiguity, exhibit good judgement, and be able to work with limited supervision.

  
  

**Required & Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience)
* Experience in program coordination, higher education, or related field
* Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* MS Word, PPT, Excel
* Sharepoint

**Preferred:**

* Experience supporting fellowship, residency, or academic programs
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical/biotech industry or clinical research environments
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Trello, Asana, Excel dashboards, Gantt charts)
* Budget tracking or financial operations experience (i.e. concur, workday)
* Survey Monkey, Qualtrics, Google Forms, Web-based surveys
  

  

The hourly rate range for this position is $32.00 - $35.50. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  
  

**This is a 6 month-fixed -term position.**

  
  
Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree, Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education Minimum Experience: 2 years Minimum Field of Expertise: Directly related professional experience in program specialization, e.g., counseling or teaching.

**Job ID** REQ20181981 **Posted Date** 10/14/2026

new_jobs.title: Southern California Program Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are + What We Do:**

Booster is a mission-driven school fundraising company focused on cultivating virtuous leaders who want to change the world. Booster partners with over 6,000 schools each year and impacts over 3 million students across all 50 states. At the heart of our culture, our six virtues guide everything we do: Gratitude, Wisdom, Care, Courage, Grit, and Celebration. We deliver engaging, innovative, and active fundraising experiences for elementary and middle schools nationwide. From high-energy fun runs to all-in-one fundraising platforms and custom gear, we’ve helped schools raise over $1 billion for education. Booster is a fun, fast-paced, and purpose-filled place to work, where every day offers the opportunity to make a real impact in the lives of students and school communities.

**Are you Booster’s Next Program Specialist?**

As a Program Specialist, you’ll be the face of the Boosterthon program on elementary school campuses. You’ll work alongside a supportive team to help schools reach their fundraising goals, deliver engaging student experiences, and create a positive impact for students and communities. This role is available in both **full-time and part-time** capacities and is ideal for someone early in their career who wants meaningful, hands-on experience.

### **How You’ll Impact Booster’s Mission:**

* Teach and present a character-based curriculum to students
* Set up and host the Boosterthon Fun Run fundraiser
* Motivate students to participate and raise funds for their school
* Engage with teachers, parents, and school administrators
* Model Fitness, Leadership, and Character as part of a team

**What You’ll Bring to The Table:**

Here are some signs that you’d be a great fit for this role:

  

* Excellent Communication - You can connect professionally and enthusiastically with students, faculty, and staff through written and verbal communication.
* Positive Attitude - You display optimism, enthusiasm, and intentionality when interacting with clients and the team.
* Growth Mindset - You demonstrate a continual desire to learn and grow both personally and professionally.
* Good Judgment - You have a strong sense of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.
* Outcome-oriented - You are a hard worker who gets things done in a timely and efficient manner.
* Enthusiastic - You connect enthusiastically with students, faculty, and staff.

**Additional Requirements:**

* You're a licensed driver with reliable transportation
* You can pass Booster's Background and Motor Vehicle check
* You're able to lift up to 45 lbs and remain active throughout the day
* Full-day availability (7:00 am–4:00 pm) on scheduled workdays

**Our Work Environment Includes:**

* Exciting and Engaging Culture: Team events, award ceremonies, epic celebration trips, free lunches, dinners, and more.
* Career Development and Advancement Opportunities
* Recruiting Bonus Opportunities
* Opportunities for National Travel

**Compensation:** $20-$21 per hour, non-exempt

***Are you ready to change the world with us? Follow us on Instagram at @boostercareers for a behind-the-scenes look at life at Booster.***

new_jobs.title: Development and Communications Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Header  
**Job Overview**  
The Development and Communications Coordinator leads Beacon Housing's fundraising, grant development, and donor engagement, including the communications that keep donors and funders connected to the work. That support keeps individuals and families vulnerable to homelessness in safe, stable, affordable homes. Reporting to the Executive Director and working closely with staff and the Operating Committee, the Coordinator moves development initiatives from planning through completion: managing timelines, coordinating input from staff and external partners, and producing polished, accurate proposals, reports, and donor materials. This position requires in-person collaboration with staff, donors, funders, Board members, and community partners, along with local travel to Beacon properties and events.

Header  
**Duties**

* Research foundation, corporate, government, and other funding opportunities aligned with Beacon Housing's priorities.
* Maintain the grants and fundraising calendar, coordinate staff contributions, and follow up so that application, reporting, donor engagement, and event deadlines are met.
* Lead grant applications from start to submission: draft proposals, coordinate staff input, gather supporting materials, and manage deadlines.
* Manage grant reporting: track requirements, gather program and financial data, draft reports, and coordinate timely submission.
* Maintain organized records of grants, funders, donors, reporting requirements, and development activities.
* Support donor cultivation and stewardship through communications, updates, acknowledgments, site visits, and other engagement.
* Oversee donor communications, including program updates and all fundraising-related campaigns and activities.
* Work closely with staff to support and coordinate production and promotion of Beacon Housing's Annual Report, with a focus on its donor and funder-facing content.
* Plan and lead fundraising events and campaigns, including the annual pickleball tournament, donor events, and crowdfunding campaigns. Manage timelines, budgets, sponsorships, vendors, invitations, registration, and follow-up.
* Develop and manage communications plans for fundraising events, campaigns, and donor engagement activities.
* Partner with the Social Media Associate to align fundraising and donor messaging across social media and other channels. The Social Media Associate manages day-to-day social media activity.
* Serve as Beacon Housing's media liaison for fundraising events, campaigns, and donor-facing milestones.
* Coordinate photographers, designers, printers, and other outside vendors for donor and fundraising materials.
* Track fundraising results and identify opportunities to strengthen the donor and funding pipeline.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Uphold Beacon Housing's mission through work performed.

Header  
**Skills and Qualifications**

Required:

* Excellent editing, proofreading, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated initiative, attention to detail, sound judgment, and follow-through.

**About Design Line**

Design Line builds complex architectural homes with high design standards, exacting detail, and challenging site conditions across the San Francisco Bay Area, Marin County, Sonoma Wine Country, and beyond.

Sage is the care intelligence platform for senior living and skilled nursing. We connect the hardware senior care runs on, including nurse call, fall management, and wander management, with software caregivers actually use. That consistent use is what produces reliable data, and reliable data is what gives operators a true picture of how their communities are running.

Sage is a collaborative team of ambitious, multi-disciplinary entrepreneurs on a mission to reinvent senior care with a modern operating system for caregivers. Millions of people depend on this care getting better, and we move with the urgency that deserves.

Sage operates with a land-and-expand motion across senior living operators. Once Sales lands a pilot, you’ll transform early wins into portfolio-wide rollouts, measurable value realization, and durable executive partnerships. You’ll refine and execute our expansion playbook, strengthen multi-level relationships, and translate the impact delivered by Product and Client Success into long-term, multi-community growth.

* Act as an executive escalation path for both Sage and operator partners; anticipate issues early and drive fast, durable resolutions
* Participate in executive meetings, conferences, and industry events to deepen relationships and unlock new growth pathways

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ years in enterprise account management, sales, or business development, ideally in B2B technology

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, AI-Native
new_jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative, AI-Native**
===============================================

**Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance company in San Francisco.** We're rebuilding the entire business as software, on a simple bet: turning expert human judgment into compute is one of the largest transitions left to make, and a trillion-dollar industry still run 90% by hand is the place to prove it. We've grown roughly 100x in the last year and we move at that speed: on-site, in person, long days, very high standards.

**The role**
------------

This is the SDR role as it will exist in 2030. You direct AI agents, automate your own workflows, and apply human judgment exactly where the machines stall. We call it being the human in the loop for top-of-funnel growth, and Harper is one of the few places in the world actually building it.

The primary job is AI-native outbound: sourcing new business owners from enriched public data, running call and email campaigns at volume not possible 3 years ago, and converting cold contacts into real opportunities. Alongside that, you own an inbound pipeline: working a power dialer of warm leads our AI agents couldn't reach, completing intake applications live on the phone, and warming up quoted leads and transferring them to the account executive (AE) team.

The best performers here don't stay SDRs. This is a deliberate first step into a sales and go-to-market career.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Run outbound at serious volume.** Cold-calls, email sequences built with our marketing team, and follow-ups. You're the first voice of Harper. Rejection is part of the rhythm.

  **Complete intake on the call.** Learn what a business does, what risk it carries, and capture everything, in minutes, not hours.

  **Build with AI, not just alongside it.** You'll use AI agents to automate your own sequencing, data entry, and reporting. Every workflow you automate becomes permanent Harper infrastructure.

  **Partner with marketing.** You're their human in the loop: feeding back what messaging lands on calls, which ad-sourced leads convert, and which segments respond.

  **Hit volume and quality targets, both.** You're measured on new leads brought in, lead conversion, completed applications, and AE transfers. You don't trade accuracy for speed or speed for accuracy.

**Who you are**
---------------

* An ambitious and personable recent grad or early-career candidate who is excited to launch a career in GTM sales.
* Excited to join the sales team at a hyper-growth AI startup disrupting the insurance industry.
* You've worked a high-volume phone role and were good at it, or you haven't, but everyone who knows you is sure you would be.
* Rejection doesn't rattle you.
* Talking to people all day energizes you. Call 50 gets the same energy as call 1.
* You reach for AI tools by instinct. When something is repetitive, your first thought is to automate it.
* You don't need hand-holding. You need a shot.

**The reality: read this before you apply**
-------------------------------------------

This is a high-volume outbound role, on-site in San Francisco, New York or Atlanta. Monday through Friday, 8am to 8pm ET, in the building with the team.

But if you're the kind of person who gets sharper as the day goes on, this is one of the fastest paths into tech sales. You'll learn an entire industry from the inside, work at an AI-native company that's actually shipping, and help define what top-of-funnel growth becomes over the next decade.

**Compensation & logistics**
----------------------------

* **Salary:** $80,000–$135,000 OTE based on experience; higher for top performers.
* **Location:** On-site, San Francisco, New York or Atlanta. Based here or willing to relocate.
* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8am–8pm ET.

**Benefits**
------------

* Uber commuter benefits
* Meals provided: breakfast, lunch, and dinner
* Snacks, drinks, and coffee stocked daily
* Free gym membership
* Health, dental, and vision insurance

**Requirements**
----------------

* Fluency in fast-paced, demanding environments (new grads OK)
* Strong multitasking ability: talk, listen, and log simultaneously
* Professional, confident, and clear on the phone
* Based in San Francisco, New York or Atlanta in-office, full-time

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Insurance, fintech, or financial-services background
* Bilingual+
* SDR or BDR roles at high-volume SaaS or AI companies
* Outbound or customer-success-focused experience

**Process**
-----------

We run a tight process and move fast, because that's how we operate.

* **AI phone screen.** A live role-play sales simulation.
* **Fit and alignment call.** Who you are, what drives you, and whether Harper is the right environment for you to do the best work of your life.
* **Super day.** 3 to 4 hours on-site: case exercises, a live cold call simulation, hands-on work with the team, and a real look at what it means to build at this level. As much for you as for us.

**To apply**
------------

Send your resume and tell us about the highest-rejection stretch of work you've ever pushed through, and why you kept dialing.

Compensation Range: $80K - $135K

Reports to: Rafael Bautista, Supervisor PD Interconnections & Planning

Travel: Up to 25%

Relocation: Some relocation assistance may be available for this position if the selected candidate currently resides outside the Atlanta area.

NOTE: This position will be filled at salary grade levels 03 - 06 Exempt

**JOB SUMMARY:**  
  
Transmission Interconnections Planning helps Georgia Power’s strategy to meet the energy needs of customers and support the state’s expected continued extraordinary growth by serving on the team that studies generator interconnection requests. A key component of the strategy is to procure up to 4,000 MW of renewable resources by 2035.

The Engineer/Project Coordinator coordinates with Southern Company Services Generation Procurement Development and Technical Shared Services, Georgia Power Project Management and other internal stakeholders to address the Georgia Power Company Owned Proposal Generation Interconnection requests providing support for the development of project scopes for Generator Step Up (GSU) Transformer Station and Gen Tie Line up to the Point of interconnection to the transmission system while meeting FERC, state, and reliability standards. This role manages communications with all parties and ensures timely, accurate responses to each request.

The position will also support tracking activities related to all existing GPC Company Owned Generation projects up to achieving in service transmission connection.
  
Candidates who do not currently live in the Metro Atlanta area may be eligible for relocation assistance, which will be evaluated individually as necessary.

This position may be filled as a salary grade SCE03, SCE04, SCE05 or SCE06. Individuals who demonstrate advanced skills in terms of work experience, education, and certifications may be eligible for the more advanced position.

**JOB DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIS:**

* Collaborate with the Transmission Interconnections Planning (IP-T) Project Manager and Transmission Project Management Organization (PMO) to define project scopes, timelines, and cost estimates for Transmission Planning related to Company Owned Proposal Generator Interconnection requests.
* Prepare project scopes for GSU and tie line, with input from various work groups including Generation Development, PMO, Transmission Design, System Operations, and Renewable and Resilient Generation.
* Coordinate closely with Estimating team and Project Controls to ensure accurate budgeting of generator interconnection GSU station and gen tie line costs estimates.
* Under technical guidance of the SCS Policy & Services Implementation Project Management group, provide necessary input on Interconnection Agreements and other related contracts and documentation per FERC guidelines and ensure interconnection contracts are thorough and meet the needs of the customer while meeting Georgia Power and Southern Company’s compliance guidelines.
* This position needs to understand and follow Standard of Conduct Policy around Generation RFPs

We are PEAK6, a leading investment firm, using technology to find a better way of doing things. **Who We Are**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.

Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.

Powered by technology and a network of 1500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

**Position Overview**  
Fooda is hiring a Content Marketing Manager to lead our content program and, over time, the team that produces it.

Fooda runs workplace food programs for employers and buildings, from rotating restaurant popups and delivery to catering and fully managed dining. Our buyers include HR and people leaders, workplace experience and facilities teams, corporate real estate, office managers, procurement, and building owners.

* Turn ideas into clear concepts, briefs, and assignments.
* Hold a high standard for everything we publish, from the strength of the idea to the final edit.

Develop the team:

* Give clear feedback that helps writers improve rather than rewriting their work.
* Manage freelance writers, including briefs, quality, and deadlines.
* Help the team become more independent and better able to turn direction into strong work.
* Take on direct management of the internal writers and freelance contributors at around six months.

Turn direction into work:

* Take broad or incomplete direction and turn it into a concrete plan.
* Find the people and information you need to get it done.
* Bring recommendations, not just questions.
* Own work from the first idea through publication.

 **Requirements**

* 7+ years in B2B content marketing, including ownership of a content or editorial program.
* At least 2 years managing writers, including coaching and developing them.
* Experience managing freelancers and other external contributors.
* A track record of creating demand generation and sales enablement content that Sales actually uses.
* Excellent editorial judgment and a high standard for written work.
* Strong interviewing, research, and storytelling skills.
* The ability to learn a new business quickly and understand what a B2B audience will find useful.
* A working knowledge of SEO and AEO.
* Comfort working with executives, Sales, customers, and subject-matter experts.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.

Experience in food, hospitality, or workplace services is welcome but not required. Strong B2B content leadership matters most.

The Content and Digital Marketing Manager leads the strategy, adaptation, and digital activation of content for U.S. Wealth Management across social media, web, CRM, and integrated campaigns. This role evaluates existing thought leadership, research, market commentary, business announcements, and other source content to identify the most relevant audience messages and translate them into channel-appropriate digital experiences that strengthen brand visibility, executive presence, client engagement, and business growth.

The manager partners with senior leaders, experts, marketers, and cross-functional teams to determine how content should be positioned, packaged, distributed, and optimized across digital channels. The role requires strong editorial judgment, digital channel expertise, and the ability to turn complex source material into concise, compelling content for distinct audiences and platforms.

**Digital Content Strategy and Planning**

* Lead the U.S. Wealth Management digital content and social media strategy in alignment with business priorities, audience needs, brand standards, and channel objectives.

* Own the editorial calendar and coordinate the activation of content across social media, web, CRM, integrated campaigns, events, sponsorships, and partnerships.

* Review thought leadership, research, market insights, podcasts, business announcements, and other source material to identify relevant themes, audience opportunities, and digital applications.

* Recommend the appropriate audience, channel, format, message, and timing for each content opportunity.

* Build coordinated content journeys that connect related assets and channels rather than treating each deliverable as a stand-alone request.

* Identify opportunities to extend the value and useful life of existing content through repurposing, sequencing, personalization, and ongoing digital distribution.

**Content Adaptation and Digital Activation**

* Translate approved source content into channel-specific assets, including social posts, executive LinkedIn content, email and CRM copy, website descriptions, landing-page content, campaign messaging, promotional copy, and advisor-facing materials.

* Distill complex wealth, investment, business ownership, and planning topics into concise, accessible messages while preserving the integrity and intent of the original material.

* Develop clear content briefs that define the audience, objective, core message, channel requirements, calls to action, and desired business outcome.

* Ensure content is adapted appropriately for each platform rather than duplicating the same language across social, web, email, and CRM.

Collaborate with experts, creative teams, agencies, and marketing partners to move content efficiently from source material through approval, production, publishing, and measurement.  



**Leadership Support/Employer Branding**

* Serve as the LinkedIn ambassador and social media advisor for U.S. Wealth Management leaders, providing strategic guidance on profile positioning, content themes, audience engagement, and platform best practices.

* Help leaders activate approved thought leadership, media coverage, announcements, events, and business priorities through authentic social content that reflects their individual voice and expertise.

* Partner with employer brand, communications, and talent teams to onboard newly hired and appointed executives, including LinkedIn profile guidance, introductory content, executive voice development, and an initial social engagement plan.

* Develop coaching, resources, templates, and recommendations that give leaders the confidence and tools to build a consistent, credible, and brand-aligned social presence.

**Digital Publishing, Governance, and Quality**

* Manage social publishing, website updates, CRM and email coordination, content approvals, and related digital workflows in partnership with enterprise channel teams.

* Apply strong editorial judgment to ensure digital content is clear, concise, accurate, audience-appropriate, and aligned with the underlying source material.

* Ensure deliverables meet regulatory, legal, compliance, brand, accessibility, and enterprise requirements.

* Maintain content standards, templates, and digital asset organization as applicable.

* Manage agency, creative partner, vendor, and internal stakeholder relationships to deliver coordinated, high-quality work efficiently.

* Balance planned editorial priorities with timely market, leadership, and business opportunities.

**Measurement and Optimization**

* Establish performance measures that connect content and digital activity to audience engagement, channel behavior, traffic quality, lead activity, and broader business objectives.

* Develop dashboards and executive summaries that communicate results, insights, and recommended actions.

* Use audience, channel, and content-performance data to refine messaging, formats, distribution, calls to action, and content journeys.

* Test and optimize digital content elements such as headlines, summaries, subject lines, calls to action, formats, and publishing cadence.

* Apply performance insights to editorial planning and future digital activation decisions.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, digital marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Five to eight years of experience in digital content marketing, social media marketing, digital channel management, lifecycle or email marketing, integrated marketing, or a related discipline.

* Demonstrated ability to review complex source material and translate it into concise, audience-focused content for social media, web, email, CRM, and other digital channels.

* Experience adapting one core piece of content or thought leadership into multiple channel-specific assets
